title: The Splinter
text: A ring of white stones, three shelters inside it, and a garden already. The people who walked out are here. Not all of them. Enough.

lines.speaker: Settler
lines.text: "Drones stay outside the stones. That's the rule here. The only rule, so far."

lines.speaker: Settler
lines.text: "We're not coming back. We're not your enemies either. We just want one place on this planet you don't see."

choices.label: Keep outside the stones
choices.reply: "Thank you," the settler says, and sounds surprised to.

choices.label: Leave them supplies
choices.reply: A hundred alloys of tools at the line of stones. By morning the tools are gone and the stones are still there.

choices.label: Ask them to come home
choices.reply: "Home," the settler says, and laughs. "Go and look at the old hull to the north. Then ask us again."
